issue.title: Multiple fixes for the release
issue.body:
- Fixes missing encoding circuit in kernel matrix parameters
- Adds seed for Executor 
- Caching Option for the ProjectedQuantumKernel
- Bug fix in QNNs that seeded qasm results are ending in different solutions
- Bug fix for Shot Control
- Bug fix for setting shots in the Executor
- Test for setting shots and getting primitives of the Executor

body: This needs to be fixed ASAP. The existing import breaks all examples that I tried, even non-kernel examples (which is very strange).

Hey @dtchang, thanks for checking out the examples <3 We're looking for a solution. Until we find one, you can still use sQUlearn with the recommended dependencies (i.e. qiskit-machine-learning<0.7.0). Also any input is appreciated!

Qiskit-ml now supports FidelitQuantumKernel and FidelityStatevectorKernel, as well as two corresponding trainable versions, with the latter providing the same performance as the deprecated QuantumKernel. I suppose sQUlearn FidelityKernel needs to be revised accordingly.

As I mentioned above, `FidelityQuantumKernel`is sadly very inefficient and thus not a real option atm. Thanks for pointing out `FidelityStatevectorKernel` though. I'll have a look if that could be an suitable option.
Please release the updates ASAP. Thanks!

issue.title: use `FidelityStatevectorKernel`
issue.body:
This PR:
- will introduce the use of `FidelityStatevectorKernel` and `TrainableFidelityStatevectorKernel` in `FidelityKernel`.
- makes `FidelityKernel` use the Statevector kernels, if the `Executor._backend` contains the string `"statevector_simulator"`, else the `FidelityQuantumKernel` based implementations will be used.
- will bump the required version of `qiskit-machine-learning` to `>=0.6.1`
- resolves #198

body: Solved and as of now available in develop branch and with next release
